parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description:
The event type of the attack event to query. Valid values:

- **defense**: traffic scrubbing events for volumetric attacks.
- **blackhole**: blackhole filtering events for volumetric attacks.

parameters.name: Ip
parameters.description: The attacked IP Address of Anti-DDoS Proxy instance.

parameters.name: Range
parameters.description: The number of data entries to return.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start timestamp of the event to query. Unit: seconds.

> You can call [DescribeDDosAllEventList](~~473646~~) to query the start time of all events.
